Privacy Policy

Draft last updated August 5, 2026.

Information you provide

This website may collect information you choose to provide when requesting an appointment. Online delivery is not currently connected, so the draft form does not transmit or store your entry.

Health information

Do not submit diagnoses, treatment histories, insurance identifiers, Social Security numbers, payment information, or other sensitive medical details through the website. Call the office for private care-related communication.

Website services

The site may load font, map, social-media, financing, and practice-content services operated by third parties. Those services may process technical information under their own policies.

Contact

Questions may be directed to The House of Dental at (407) 678-1400 or 6504 University Blvd, Winter Park, FL 32792.
